2. Website hosting

This website is delivered through ChatGPT Sites. Standard technical request information—such as IP address, access time, requested URL, browser, and device information—may be processed to deliver, secure, and maintain the website.

3. Contact by email

If you email us, we process your email address, message, and any name you provide so we can answer your request. Messages are deleted when the request is complete unless legal retention duties apply. Please do not email unnecessary health information, payment-card details, or passwords. This address is not an emergency or counseling service.

4. Gumroad purchases and free downloads

Purchases and downloads of the workbook, book, and certain other digital products take place on Gumroad. When you open a Gumroad link, you leave this website. Gumroad operates the checkout and handles payment, applicable taxes, and digital delivery as merchant of record.

Gumroad may process information including your name, email address, billing and payment information, IP address, and transaction and download details. The seller may receive buyer and order information needed for fulfillment, customer support, accounting, and legal obligations. We do not receive or store your full payment-card number. See Gumroad’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

Buyer and order information we receive is used only for contract fulfillment, customer support, fraud prevention, accounting, and compliance with legal obligations, and is retained only as long as needed for those purposes or required by law.

5. Other external links

Emergency and educational links lead to third-party websites. Their own privacy notices apply after you select those links.

6. Cookies, analytics, and advertising

We currently do not use Google Analytics, Google AdSense, or comparable first-party marketing or audience-measurement services, and we do not place non-essential advertising or analytics cookies. If that changes, this notice will be updated before those services are enabled and consent will be requested where required.

7. Data sharing and international processing

Information is shared only with service providers as needed to operate the website, answer requests, fulfill orders, or comply with law. Depending on the provider’s terms, information may be processed outside your country or the European Economic Area.

8. Your choices and rights

You may request access, correction, or deletion of personal information we control by emailing weiszhab@gmail.com. Visitors in the European Economic Area may also have rights to restrict or object to processing, data portability, and to complain to a supervisory authority. The Hungarian authority is the National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (NAIH), www.naih.hu.

This notice describes the site’s current operation and sales flow. It is general information and not a substitute for individualized legal advice.
